meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Big Pudgy Problem
start.text:
''Between the rows of gnarled grape vines, three small red shapes bounce and sizzle in the afternoon heat. An older man stands at the edge of the path, pruning shears clutched uselessly in both hands, waving them in the air.''

Tunner: Help me! Help me!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Pyro Slimes terrorizing Tunner's grape vines at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg and click Fight the Pyro Slimes. Defeat 3 [[Pyro Slime]]s

slimes_ded.text:
''The last Pyro Slime bursts with a soft pop and fades into a curl of smoke. The nearest vine is singed at its tips but still standing.''

''Tunner shuffles forward from the path, one hand pressed to his chest, breathing in slow steadying pulls.''

Tunner: Oh... oh my. Thank you, thank you. I thought that was the end of my grapes for certain.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Talk to Tunner at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg and click Talk to Tunner

talk_to_tunner.text:
Tunner: I just wanted to tend to the grape vines, and then... this happened.

Tunner: ''sigh'' Please don't say a word about this to my son. He's one of the Knights of Favonius, so I'm sure he has enough to worry about as it is.

Tunner: There's no need to bother him over a silly old man getting himself into a bit of a pickle.

Tunner: Recently, though, we do seem to be having a bit of a slime problem around the winery area. I worry constantly that they'll demolish my grape vines. It's keeping me up at night.

Tunner: I don't know if you have the time to spare for an old man like me... but if so, could you chase off the slimes in the area for me, to stop them from getting at my grapes?

nowayoldman.title: Turned Down
nowayoldman.text:
''Tunner's face falls slightly. He gives a small, resigned nod.''

Tunner: I understand. You've already done more than enough for this old man. Thank you for what you did, at least.

''He turns back to inspect the scorched vine tips, muttering quietly to himself as you go.''

syrehthing.text:
Tunner: ''brightens considerably'' Oh, bless you! There were a couple more lurking near the far end of the vineyard when I came out this morning. I heard them from the cellar.

Tunner: Please, be careful. I'll wait right here.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Clear the slimes from the winery area for Tunner

continues.label: Do /rpg then click Clear the Slimes. Defeat 2 [[Cryo Slime]]s and 1 [[Anemo Slime]]

slimes_cleared.title: Slimes Cleared
slimes_cleared.text:
''The last slime dissolves into nothing. The vineyard is quiet at last, just wind off the mountains and the distant rumble of wine barrels being rolled in the cellar below.''

Tunner: ''peering around the corner of the vine row, eyes wide'' They're gone? They're really gone?

Tunner: ''exhales a long breath'' Oh, thank the Archons. My grapes are safe.

''He presses a small purse into your hands, squeezing your fingers gently before letting go.''

Tunner: Please. Take this. And not a word to my son.
